gaps.g1: `int om_mission_production_slot(const om_world *w, uint32_t structure, double *out_x, double *out_y)` in csrc/mission.c, declared in csrc/om_internal.h with a signatures.toml row and an EXPECTED_MODULE line; returns 1 and the slot's world position, or 0 when no slot within the bound is free (the caller delays one tick, timer kept). The isolation test binds it through tests/csim/conftest.py's internal-symbol binding (the reason the row owns conftest.py); the integration test goes through production itself.
gaps.g2: Origin: the structure's point P. Axes: world x and y. Spacing s = 2 x OM_UNIT_COLLISION_RADIUS, the same constant mission start uses (mission.c:2470). Slots: P + (i s, j s) for integers i, j, the slot (0, 0) excluded (the structure's own point). Ring r = max(|i|, |j|); scan order: rings r = 1, 2, 3, ... outward and within a ring row-major (j, the y offset, outer from -r to r; i, the x offset, inner from -r to r; keeping only the cells with max(|i|, |j|) == r), a fixed order and not nearest-first past ring 3, which is the rule: 'the first free slot in the fixed scan order' replaces the spec's 'nearest free slot'. Bound (Architect 2026-10-21, exact in integers): a slot counts when i*i + j*j <= OM_PRODSLOT_RING_MAX * OM_PRODSLOT_RING_MAX, with OM_PRODSLOT_RING_MAX = (OM_REINFORCEMENT_CAPTURE_RADIUS / 2) / OM_PRODSLOT_SPACING_WU and OM_PRODSLOT_SPACING_WU = 2 * OM_UNIT_COLLISION_RADIUS, both defined in om_internal.h beside the prototype with a static assert that the division is exact (5 today, 80 slots at ring 5); no Euclidean test, no bare literal (R-126-02's 'within half the capture radius', 150 wu inclusive). Free: no live unit's position is within strictly less than s of the slot (squared distances compared, no epsilon); a unit at exactly s does not block. Terrain: a slot om_unit_spawn would refuse is skipped as occupied.
gaps.g3: R-126-02 becomes `- R-126-02  Given a held structure with a chosen unit type, When its production timer reaches 30 s × (that type's power / 100), Then one unit of that type spawns at the first free slot of the structure's spawn lattice (a grid at twice the unit collision radius centred on the structure, scanned ring by ring outward in a fixed order, within half the capture radius; a slot is free when no live unit stands within one spacing of it; no free slot delays production one tick) on the structure's layer, with no random draw, and the timer subtracts the interval (Westley 2026-10-12, TD-VG-E-29).`; E-15:184 becomes `- Same seed, same spawns and drift, all platforms (every draw comes from the world stream; production placement draws nothing, R-126-02).`; ALG-75's "on expiry a unit spawns at a random point within ..." clause becomes "on expiry a unit spawns at the first free lattice slot within half the capture radius (R-126-02); no draw"; E-15:199 "- Spawn position from an unseeded RNG." becomes "- Spawn position from any RNG draw, or from a scan whose order depends on unit order or platform (R-126-02: a fixed lattice scan, no draw)."; the closed Q-126-02 row's answer cell gains " Superseded 2026-10-12 (Westley's rule change, TD-VG-E-29): production placement draws nothing; the slot lattice decides."; the eight tests' docstrings cite the new rule text, assertions untouched (all bound at 150 inclusive, so green).

Inside the helper one cast (om_world *)w at the two accessor calls (om_structure_get_position, om_structure_get_unit_type), with the comment 'read-only use through non-const accessors; the pattern of om_mission_reinforce_cap, mission.c:3127'. The private struct stays private; no new accessor. (5) Terrain refusal: duplicated in the helper (unit.c is owned by queued pieces LAB-REV2-E0/E1/E1B/E2/E4 and VG-T-R087-WIRE). The helper carries 'See also: csrc/unit.c om_unit_spawn_internal :934-941, duplicated because unit.c is not owned here; FU-spawn-terrain-check-shared'. Ledger row FU-spawn-terrain-check-shared: 'the next piece that owns unit.c (LAB-REV2-E0 is first) extracts om_unit_spawn_terrain_ok from both sites and adds the See-also at unit.c'. Positive control for the duplicate: on a terrain fixture the helper refuses exactly the points om_unit_spawn refuses for a walker (band 0 and an unwalkable cell), and accepts a flyer there. (6) Float boundary: the helper keeps 'squared distances, no epsilon' (d2 < s*s). On a non-integer structure point rounding may skip one neighbour slot; that is deterministic and harmless (the next slot in order takes it), and the helper's comment says so. Tests: the fixture structure stands on an integer point so P + i*s is exact, the expected slot sequence is computed from the integer lattice, and the pairwise assertion is d2 >= 900 - 1e-6 (tolerance in the test only, DRAFT-prodslot-test-tol 1e-6 wu^2). (7) Ring order and bound: see g2 as corrected (j outer, i inner; integer bound with OM_PRODSLOT_RING_MAX and OM_PRODSLOT_SPACING_WU in om_internal.h, static assert exact division, no bare literal, no Euclidean test). (8) State after the change: on a placed production last_spawn_x and last_spawn_y hold the slot, last_spawn_distance holds the slot's distance to the structure (sqrt of the exact double s*s*(i*i+j*j); IEEE sqrt is correctly rounded, no transcendental); on a blocked tick nothing changes: timer not decremented (the retry comes from timer >= interval next tick), pending_spawns and last_spawn_* untouched. The eight tests keep their assertions. (9) No play, no shot: sim only. (10) E-15:199 is rewritten as listed in g3. (11) Scale pin: no new test. The row comment states the bound: at most 80 slots x live units of distance checks per production event (not per tick); the E-15 scale requirement (8 structures under 0.2 ms per tick) belongs to the existing scale suite. The clerk's rewrite of TD-VG-E-29 and FINDING-production-stack ('first free slot in scan order of the 30 wu lattice', current lines) is approved.
